english.title: Member State producer placing on market or selling EEE in UK fail to appoint representative

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a producer who was established in a Member State other than the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY STATE..), and

(A)_[placed EEE onto the market]_
(B)_[sold EEE by means of distance communication directly to consumers]_

in the United Kingdom, failed to appoint an authorised representative in the United Kingdom to fulfil your producer obligations under the Waste Electrical and Electronic Regulations 2013 on your behalf or comply with the requirements of regulation 14(1) of those regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(2), 90(1) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a producer established in a member state other than the UK
and placed EEE on the market / sold EEE by means of distance communication directly to consumers in the UK
failed to appoint authorised representative in UK to fulfil producer obligations under regs or comply with 14(1)

Indictment: A fine
